question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

The encounter made the audience __squirm__
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"squirm"** means to wriggle or twist the body from side to side, especially as a result of nervousness or discomfort. (कसमसाना)

 
 
• **Example: **He began to** squirm** in his seat when the teacher asked him a question.
 
 
 
• **"Relax" **means to make or become less tense or anxious; to rest or unwind. (आराम करना)
 
 
• **Example: **After a long day at work, I like to relax with a good book.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'squirm' **is **'relax'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Chat **(बातचीत): To engage in informal conversation.

 
 
• **Example:** We had a pleasant **chat** over coffee.
 
 
 
• **Pray **(प्रार्थना करना): To address a solemn request or expression of thanks to a deity or other object of worship.
 
 
• **Example: **Every morning, she **prays **for her family's well-being.
 
 
 
• **Speak** (बोलना): To articulate or communicate in speech.
 
 
• **Example:** He was invited to** speak** at the conference.
